info.description: Singleton: global on/off toggle + default commission rate. Rate is snapshotted onto each accrued commission at deposit time, so changing the value here NEVER retroactively re-computes existing commissions — it only affects deposits confirmed after the change.

enabled.description: Global kill switch. When false, NO new commissions accrue for anyone. Previously accrued commissions remain intact and visible.

defaultRatePercent.description: Default commission percentage applied to every qualifying deposit unless the affiliate has a per-affiliate override. Interpreted as a percent (5 = 5%).

holdPeriodDays.description: Days a new commission stays in 'pending' state before it becomes withdrawable ('approved'). If the source deposit is refunded / reversed / charged back during this window, the pending commission is cancelled with no wallet movement. Setting to 0 disables holdback (immediate approval). Snapshot on each ledger row at accrual — changing this value never mutates rows already in flight.

depositRetentionThresholdPct.description: Anti-wash-cycle guard. At commission-approval time (cron), the referred user must have kept at least this percentage of what they deposited on the platform since the source deposit — money withdrawn to bank/card counts as an outflow, money spent on orders does NOT. If retention falls below this threshold, the commission is cancelled with no wallet movement (referred_user_net_outflow). Set to 0 to disable this check.
